explanation.text: WHO World Malaria Report 2015 states the global estimated malaria cases in 2015 were 214 million (range 149–303 million), not 273 million. The 273 million figure is absent from the cited sources.
Multiple spans from the World Malaria Report 2015 consistently report 214 million estimated cases for 2015, contradicting the claim of 273 million as the placed number.
The assertion that WHO placed new malaria cases at 273 million in 2015 is contradicted by the primary WHO reports, which give the 2015 estimate as 214 million.
